scene-u01-pnew3-4.name: text#4
scene-u01-pnew3-4.text: Draw sequence matching as a path on a grid: each node is one pairing, and the lowest-cost path is the distance

scene-u01-pnew3-6.name: text#6
scene-u01-pnew3-6.text: Summing node costs along a path gives the total cost $D$; the lowest-cost path also gives the point-by-point alignment. But there are $681$ paths, too many to pick by eye.
